paper_title: Search for ultralight dark matter from long-term frequency comparisons of optical and microwave atomic clocks
notes: Yb optical lattice / Cs fountain clock comparison over 298 days searching for oscillating scalar DM. New limits set on d_me (electron mass coupling) and d_g (gluon coupling) over m_phi = 1e-22 to 1e-20 eV. Paper's primary highlighted new result is on d_me, best limit d_me <~ 1.6e-6 at m_phi ~ 5e-22 eV (improved by ~1000x). Data points approximate: explicit value 1.6e-6 at 5e-22 eV from text; other points estimated from linear scaling (coupling ~ proportional to frequency/mass at fixed amplitude limit) as shown in Fig. 4(b). d_g limits also new below 1e-21 eV but ScalarElectron chosen as the emphasized result. Assumes local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3; limits rescaled by factor 3.0 for stochastic interference. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 4))
